subject: C6r texture regression: code-cache batch-reuse/eviction hypothesis REJECTED (source review)
body: Reviewed 665a404 bridge (sha of git show saved in scratch). (1) Batch shader reuse (draw_batch_locked prev_vs/prev_fs): a reused BO always originates from a cached_code() call earlier in the SAME batch, which set code_used=++code_clock > code_protect (=code_clock at batch start); eviction (cached_code victim loop) and code_reclaim both skip code_used>pin/code_protect, so no later miss in the batch can evict it. An uncached BO (e==1) sits in uncached[] and is dropped only after jm_submit; kernel n2c_bo_release defers the free while refs>1||x->jobs (gpu/src/nord2_gpu_core.c:859), so queued async jobs keep evicted code alive. bos[] is a fixed array (no realloc). (2) Host-copy compare: code_copy[i] is freed/replaced at every site that changes code[i] (code_reclaim, victim eviction, insert, close) - cannot match a recycled entry. (3) ad94559 working tree: CODE_SLOTS 128/24MiB + code_key: key set only at insert, lookup still confirmed by code_equal; looks correct. Thrash costs kernel calls but cannot select wrong code. Other C6r cuts reviewed OK: v2 sidecar in place (consumers read [0,count), each entry memset), slot arena (all fields read are assigned), render.c half-clear (fixed layout < 8192, payload tail only via sidecar; guard if(!tr&&payload_cursor) FAIL), shadowScan cache (calloc'd jobs, covers same 63 slots). Continuing with: metal2vulkan pin change 68dffdee->edb177a6 (C6q) and pipeline-cache scope default all->compilers (C6q) as out-of-gpu/metal suspects.
